text: Binary per-row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parsed): 1 if at least one comment itself gives a concrete real-world example supporting its argument, meaning a specific actual case, event, person, institution, data instance or personal experience that really occurred (any type qualifies; need not be externally verified). Purely abstract principles, generic claims, and invented or hypothetical scenarios do not count. Output 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment qualifies, or if it is a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. List order is irrelevant. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may count if relevant.
